prompt:
Use case: structural graphic character redesign.
User's latest specific direction: 保留幼态；紫色的蝴蝶斗篷很大；整体三角型趋势。
Make ONE complete character with a DOMINANT LARGE PURPLE BUTTERFLY CLOAK and a decisive TRIANGULAR SILHOUETTE: narrow at head/shoulders, broad at lower cloak hem.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is ONLY the girl's identity: gentle youthful chibi face, silver-white hair, lavender eyes, paired purple horns, pointed ears, modest Chinese fantasy clothing. Its sleeve-dominated silhouette and soft rendering MUST be redesigned.
Images 2 and 3 are the PRIMARY PAINTING-STYLE authority: thick confident dark outlines, few strong connected color planes, bold saturated colors, matte hand-painted icon clarity and clearly separated lit and shadow faces. Match this game gem-icon graphic treatment, not image 1's soft anime gradients. The character remains a clothed person, not a crystalline statue.

YOUTHFUL, WHOLESOME CHARACTER:
Clearly young chibi fantasy girl, soft round face, large kind simple lavender eyes, tiny warm smile; approximately THREE actual head heights crown-to-sole excluding horns, compact short limbs. Fully covered modest Chinese ivory/violet cross-collar tunic and knee-length ruqun, opaque dark leggings, simple low flat cloth boots. No adult curves, fitted corset, exposed torso, thigh exposure, sexy expression or sexualized pose.
Preserve her silver-white hair grouped into THREE quiet broad locks, curved dark-purple paired horns with simple broad purple inlay, elf ears and small forehead jewel. Keep horn extension compact so the head forms the apex of the total design without excessive spikes.

PRIMARY DESIGN — ONE BIG BUTTERFLY CLOAK, NOT BUTTERFLY SLEEVES:
Replace the huge decorative wing sleeves with ONE coherent oversized purple BUTTERFLY CLOAK attached at the shoulders/neck with a small plain clasp. Ordinary modest sleeves stay inside it; do not add extra wing sleeves.
The cloak must dominate the silhouette, flowing from a narrow shoulder root down and outward into TWO broad sides, its widest region near lower skirt/calf height. The complete character outline should clearly read as an A-shaped TRIANGLE with head at apex and an expansive cloak base. Cloak width around lower hem approximately 2.5 times shoulder width; it occupies most of the character's side silhouette. Real thick cloth hanging with gravity, not rigid detached wings.
Its two main side panels imply butterfly wings through a long broad upper wing curve and a smaller tapered lower wing/tail on each side. Use only a FEW intentional contour changes: long sloping edges, one strong soft curve, one clear notch and a tapered hem corner. NO rows of equal round petals or flower-fan scallops. Keep the overall large triangular trend despite a subtle asymmetric drape and three-quarter perspective.
Near cape panel spreads lower-left in a broad purple diagonal; far cape panel is slightly foreshortened behind her and spreads lower-right. Show ONE broad turned dark inner face and ONE big ridge catching light, clear physical attachment at shoulders and a readable center opening revealing the small clothed body. Cloth thickness and fold orientation must be apparent.
Mark each side with ONE large simple lavender butterfly wing-eye or curved wing band, following the fabric's planes and shadow. Very small pale-cyan accents only; PURPLE remains dominant. No repeated butterfly logos on forehead, belt, skirt, boots and floating particles. No floating butterfly needed.

TRIANGULAR SHAPE RHYTHM:
Small calm head -> narrow cloud-shaped shoulder yoke -> compact plain upper body -> widening cloak -> broad stable lower cloak hem. Do not make it a round hair-and-sleeves ball. Keep the long back hair contained INSIDE the cloak outline and reduce side hair spread. The small two boot tips are fully visible below the cloak and separated by a clear gap.
One hand gently rests near the cloak clasp, the other lightly gathers the front cloak edge beside the waist. Relaxed elbows, graceful modest standing with slight weight shift and one knee soft; face, torso and feet three-quarter LEFT about 40 degrees. No wide warrior stance, claws, fan, weapon, pin-up or dancing.

GEM-ICON PAINTING:
Use bold deep-ink-purple outlines and 2–3 LARGE coherent color/value shapes per major material. Rich violet main plane, deep dark-purple turned plane, broad controlled lavender upper plane; sparse dry-brush trace only within large planes. Crisp simple shading that explains volumes. Hair = ivory white base plus ONE broad cool-lavender shadow per large lock. Face = simple warm flat skin plus one soft broad shadow. No glossy anime shine, airbrushed gradients, fine strands, countless tiny polygon triangles, glitter or photorealistic jewelry.
The drawing must feel graphic, substantial and simplified like images 2/3. One beautiful finished design, full figure and entire cloak in a square canvas with 7–8 percent safe margins, plain uniform warm ivory background. No title, text, frame, inset rectangle, shadow, scenery or multiple options.
purpose: User-requested youthful character with an oversized purple butterfly cloak and overall triangular silhouette.
visual_review: Oversized connected purple butterfly cloak now widens toward lower hem into a triangular silhouette; youthful face, modest cross-collar outfit, compact body and visible boots retained.
